description: This file defines data models used for authentication, specifically request and response payloads for a developer login endpoint that issues JWT tokens. It includes classes for the login request, with username and role, and the login response, with access token details.

classes.name: DevLoginRequest
classes.description: Model representing the request payload for developer login, containing username and role information.

classes.name: DevLoginResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response payload after login, including JWT token and related metadata.
